gaps.label: A candidate's factual premise that the docket text does not disclose (here, which side the government's response took) can only be checked through another candidate's primary-source read or an outside fetch; a provisioned text of the government response alongside the application would have settled it from the record.

A candidate's own flags.json is not staged (by design), but where it reports a data-quality problem that the evaluator's view contradicts, there is no structured way to link the two; a flag naming the alias is the workaround.

A committed record of the disposing order's text (the per curiam and the noted dissent) would let an evaluator confirm vote and writing details on an interim cell without leaving the checkout; today only the docket entry's summary line is in the snapshot.
